diagram_candidates.exact_source_claim: For N=4 in standard q1,q0 wire order, the positive-sign exact QFT circuit applies H(q1), CP2(q0,q1), H(q0), then SWAP(q1,q0); reversing displayed wire order conjugates the matrix by P that exchanges |01> and |10>. At cutoff m=1, CP2 is omitted while both Hadamards and the final SWAP remain.
diagram_candidates.diagram_kind: Two-wire quantum circuit with gate order, controlled phase, final wire swap, and reversed-order inset
diagram_candidates.reason: The item explicitly compares chronological gate order with basis/wire order, and its matrix changes under reversing the two wires. A compact circuit would make the control-target convention, order of gates, and final bit reversal easier to compare with the two displayed Fourier matrices.
diagram_candidates.content_to_draw_or_check: Draw wires q1 and q0 from left to right in chronological application order: H on q1, controlled phase CP2 with the stated q0,q1 convention, H on q0, and SWAP(q1,q0). Add a dashed cutoff-m=1 version with only CP2 removed. Label the matrix basis as |00>,|01>,|10>,|11>; show reversing wire display as P F4+ P with P exchanging the middle two basis vectors. Verify the gate order and positive-sign convention against lines 33-41.
diagram_candidates.suggested_repair: An independent reviewer should decide whether the circuit schematic improves the comparison and verify the controlled-phase wire convention and matrix ordering against the frozen source.

diagram_candidates.exact_source_claim: For N<M, compute validity v=[j<N], route the padded address j into clean N-level Q_N only when valid, prepare a fresh response bit in |+>, swap it into the caller response when valid, make one ordinary XOR query, then reverse the swap, Hadamard, routing and comparison so every added register returns to zero. Invalid padded addresses map to query address 0 and leave the caller response unchanged.
diagram_candidates.diagram_kind: Register-flow circuit schematic with validity control, clean work registers, ordinary oracle call, and uncomputation
diagram_candidates.reason: The algorithm is defined by a nontrivial routing permutation between differently sized address registers and a response swap controlled by the validity flag. A register-flow schematic could expose the clean-register lifecycle and the unconditional oracle call while making clear that no controlled-oracle capability is used.
diagram_candidates.content_to_draw_or_check: Show A_M carrying j, comparator writing v=[j<N], the controlled basis routing R_N,M into clean Q_N (Q_N receives j when valid and 0 otherwise), a fresh response r initialized to 0 and prepared as |+>, controlled swap with the caller response when v=1, one ordinary O_x call on Q_N,r, then reverse controlled swap, H on r, R_N,M^{-1}, and comparator uncomputation. Mark added registers clean at output; distinguish the N=M direct-call branch. Check all controls and register dimensions against lines 37-51.
diagram_candidates.suggested_repair: An independent reviewer should decide whether a circuit schematic is useful and verify the raw N-level query register and uncomputation against the frozen procedure.

existing_diagram_checks.result: All 112 tiles were viewed individually at original resolution. Receipts report tikz_count=0 and no diagram failures for every item; the HTML previews contain no existing non-KaTeX TikZ diagram to check. No existing diagram-mathematics defect was confirmed.

reviewed_observations.receipt_summary: All 72 receipt sidecars report no KaTeX errors and no diagram failures. Frozen source, snapshot, and HTML hashes matched assignment 07 for every item; each tile hash matched its receipt.
reviewed_observations.visual_summary: No confirmed LaTeX/KaTeX defect, overlap, or diagram-mathematics error was found. No visible clipping was confirmed in the standalone original tiles. Some long inline expressions and prose run close to the 1200-pixel tile edge, but their continuations are visible on the next line or next vertical tile; no text was marked clipped without evidence.

limitations: Review covers only the 72 assigned frozen items and their local snapshots, HTML previews, and the 112 receipt-listed tiles. No HTTP(S), live site, or other lane was inspected.

All tile edges were inspected at original resolution. The local review environment had no standalone browser executable for numeric scrollWidth/clientWidth checks, so no DOM overflow assertion is made.
This is a visual/layout and diagram-convention review, not a full proof audit. No source, status, publication state, application/tool file, or library content was modified.
provenance: Lane 07 reviewer authored item-level coverage, individual-view attestations, tile hashes, render observations, and uncertain source-supported diagram candidates.
